## Summary

Resolved persistent pod evictions on worker-node-7 caused by DiskPressure due to /var/lib/containerd reaching 94% capacity. The root cause was a misconfigured kubelet setting where imageGCHighThresholdPercent was raised to 95%, preventing automatic garbage collection.
